mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard_integration_lease(lease_key,owner,expires_at) VALUES(#{key},#{owner},TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{seconds},NOW(3))) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner=IF(expires_at <= NOW(3),VALUES(owner),owner), expires_at=IF(owner=VALUES(owner),VALUES(expires_at),expires_at)
mapper.select: SELECT owner FROM dashboard_integration_lease WHERE lease_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dashboard_integration_lease WHERE lease_key=#{key} AND owner=#{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT payload_ciphertext AS payloadCiphertext,captured_at AS capturedAt, fresh_until AS freshUntil,expires_at AS expiresAt FROM dashboard_integration_snapshot WHERE snapshot_key=#{key} AND expires_at > NOW(3)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard_integration_snapshot(snapshot_key,source_code,endpoint_code,payload_ciphertext,captured_at,fresh_until,expires_at) VALUES(#{key},#{source},#{endpoint},#{ciphertext},NOW(3),TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{freshSeconds},NOW(3)),TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{retentionSeconds},NOW(3))) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload_ciphertext=VALUES(payload_ciphertext),captured_at=VALUES(captured_at), fresh_until=VALUES(fresh_until),expires_at=VALUES(expires_at)

INSERT INTO dashboard_integration_alert(alert_key,resource_code,error_code,first_at,last_at) VALUES(#{key},#{resource},#{code},NOW(3),NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE occurrences=occurrences+1,status='OPEN',last_at=NOW(3),acknowledged_by=''

INSERT INTO dashboard_integration_alert(alert_key,category,resource_code,error_code,first_at,last_at) VALUES(#{key},#{category},#{resource},#{code},NOW(3),NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE occurrences=occurrences+1,status='OPEN',last_at=NOW(3),acknowledged_by=''
mapper.select: SELECT audit_id AS auditId,category,resource_code AS resourceCode,request_id AS requestId,outcome,actor, byte_count AS byteCount,duration_ms AS durationMs,created_at AS createdAt FROM dashboard_integration_audit category=#{category} ORDER BY audit_id DESC

SELECT alert_id AS alertId,category,resource_code AS resourceCode,error_code AS errorCode,occurrences,status, first_at AS firstAt,last_at AS lastAt,acknowledged_by AS acknowledgedBy FROM dashboard_integration_alert ORDER BY last_at DESC

SELECT audit_id AS auditId,category,resource_code AS resourceCode,request_id AS requestId,outcome,actor, byte_count AS byteCount,duration_ms AS durationMs,created_at AS createdAt FROM dashboard_integration_audit WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY audit_id DESC

SELECT alert_id AS alertId,category,resource_code AS resourceCode,error_code AS errorCode,occurrences,status, first_at AS firstAt,last_at AS lastAt,acknowledged_by AS acknowledgedBy FROM dashboard_integration_alert WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY last_at DESC,alert_id DESC

SELECT
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_message m JOIN dashboard_integration i ON i.integration_id=m.integration_id WHERE m.status IN ('RECEIVED','PROCESSING','FAILED','RETRYING') ) AS pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_message m JOIN dashboard_integration i ON i.integration_id=m.integration_id WHERE m.status='DEAD_LETTER' ) AS deadLetters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_record r JOIN dashboard_integration i ON i.integration_id=r.integration_id WHERE r.status='ACTIVE' ) AS records,
0 AS pending,0 AS deadLetters,0 AS records,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_alert WHERE status='OPEN' ) AS openAlerts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_audit WHERE category IN ('OUTBOUND','INBOUND','MEDIA') AND created_at > TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-24,NOW()) ) AS requests24h, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_audit WHERE category IN ('OUTBOUND','INBOUND','MEDIA') AND outcome NOT IN ('SUCCESS','NO_DATA','ACCEPTED') AND created_at > TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-24,NOW()) ) AS failures24h, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_audit WHERE category='INBOUND_RETENTION' AND created_at > TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-24,NOW()) ) AS retentionRuns24h, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_audit WHERE category='WEBSOCKET' AND created_at > TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-24,NOW()) ) AS websocketEvents24h

SELECT 'OUTBOUND' AS category,source_code AS resourceCode,source_name AS resourceName,source_type AS sourceType FROM dashboard_data_source WHERE source_type='HTTP' UNION ALL SELECT 'WEBSOCKET',source_code,source_name,source_type FROM dashboard_data_source WHERE source_type='WEBSOCKET' UNION ALL SELECT 'MEDIA',s.source_code,s.source_name,s.source_type FROM dashboard_data_source s WHERE s.source_type='HTTP' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dashboard_data_source_endpoint e WHERE e.data_source_id=s.data_source_id AND e.response_type='BINARY_MEDIA') UNION ALL SELECT 'INBOUND',integration_code,integration_name,'INBOUND' FROM dashboard_integration UNION ALL SELECT 'INBOUND_RETENTION',integration_code,integration_name,'INBOUND' FROM dashboard_integration ORDER BY category,resourceName,resourceCode
SELECT CONCAT(source_code,'/',endpoint_code) FROM dashboard_integration_media_ref WHERE SHA2(media_ref,256)=#{hash} LIMIT 1
SELECT CONCAT(source_code,'/',endpoint_code) FROM dashboard_integration_media_ref WHERE media_ref=#{mediaRef}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_message WHERE status IN ('RECEIVED','PROCESSING','FAILED','RETRYING')) AS pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_message WHERE status='DEAD_LETTER') AS deadLetters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_record WHERE status='ACTIVE') AS records, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_alert WHERE status='OPEN') AS openAlerts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_audit WHERE created_at > TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-24,NOW())) AS requests24h, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard_integration_audit WHERE outcome NOT IN ('SUCCESS','NO_DATA','ACCEPTED') AND created_at > TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-24,NOW())) AS failures24h
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard_integration_signal(integration_id,version,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},1,NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT version FROM dashboard_integration_signal WHERE integration_id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dashboard_integration_snapshot WHERE expires_at < NOW(3) LIMIT 1000
DELETE FROM dashboard_integration_audit WHERE created_at < TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,-#{days},NOW()) LIMIT 1000
DELETE FROM dashboard_integration_lease WHERE expires_at < TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-1,NOW()) LIMIT 1000
